# Dialog in the bootstrap look

Its parts, props and data attributes: [Dialog](https://menhir-ui.com/docs/components/dialog.md).

## DialogExample.tsx

```tsx
import { Dialog } from "menhir/dialog";

import button from "../../../looks/bootstrap/button.module.css";
import styles from "./dialog.module.css";

export default function DialogExample() {
  return (
    <Dialog.Root>
      <Dialog.Trigger class={[button.button, button.secondary]}>
        Edit profile
      </Dialog.Trigger>
      <Dialog.Popup class={styles.popup}>
        <div class={styles.header}>
          <Dialog.Title class={styles.title}>Edit profile</Dialog.Title>
        </div>
        <div class={styles.body}>
          <Dialog.Description class={styles.description}>
            Your name is shown on your posts.
          </Dialog.Description>
          <label class={styles.label}>
            Name
            <input name="name" value="Ada Lovelace" class={styles.control} />
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class={styles.footer}>
          <Dialog.Close class={[button.button, button.primary]}>
            Done
          </Dialog.Close>
        </div>
        {/* Last, so that opening focuses the field. A modal <dialog> is
            position: fixed, which positions the button against it. */}
        <Dialog.Close class={[button.close, styles.cornerClose]}>
          <svg
            aria-hidden="true"
            viewBox="0 0 16 16"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            stroke-width="2"
            stroke-linecap="round"
            stroke-linejoin="round"
          >
            <path d="M2 2l12 12M14 2 2 14" />
          </svg>
          <span class={button.visuallyHidden}>Close</span>
        </Dialog.Close>
      </Dialog.Popup>
    </Dialog.Root>
  );
}
```

## dialog.module.css

```css
/* Bootstrap's modal: a header, a body and a footer, separated by borders,
   that slides down from above the page as it fades in. The <dialog> is in
   the top layer and ::backdrop covers the page, so there is no
   .modal-backdrop element and no z-index. The Popup is hidden while closed,
   so it takes no display of its own: its three parts are blocks. */
.popup {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: calc(100% - 2 * var(--spacer-2));
  max-width: 500px;
  margin: 1.75rem auto auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius-lg);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  background-clip: padding-box;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  transition:
    opacity 0.15s linear,
    transform 0.3s ease-out;
}

.popup:focus-visible {
  outline: 0;
}

/* Exit: Menhir keeps the Popup shown until this transition ends. */
.popup[data-closed] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-50px);
}

/* Entry: where the Popup starts from when it opens. */
@starting-style {
  .popup[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-50px);
  }
}

.popup::backdrop {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-black) 50%, transparent);
  transition: opacity 0.15s linear;
}

.popup[data-closed]::backdrop {
  opacity: 0;
}

@starting-style {
  .popup[data-open]::backdrop {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  /* Room for the corner close. */
  padding: var(--spacer-3) calc(2 * var(--spacer-3) + 1.5em) var(--spacer-3)
    var(--spacer-3);
  border-bottom: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color);
}

.title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.cornerClose {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--spacer-3) + 0.1875rem);
  right: var(--spacer-3);
}

.body {
  padding: var(--spacer-3);
}

.description {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacer-3);
}

.label {
  display: block;
}

/* Bootstrap's .form-control, below its label. */
.control {
  display: block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: var(--spacer-2);
  padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem;
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  background-clip: padding-box;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  font: inherit;
  appearance: none;
  transition:
    border-color 0.15s ease-in-out,
    box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.control:focus-visible {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-white) 50%, var(--bs-primary));
  outline: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--bs-focus-ring-width) var(--bs-focus-ring-color);
}

.control::placeholder {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  opacity: 1;
}

.footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: var(--spacer-2);
  padding: var(--spacer-3);
  border-top: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .popup,
  .popup::backdrop,
  .control {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```
